subject: Running Shiny on IPad without internet connection?

messages.author: c2edf3104ceaed2e
messages.subject: Running Shiny on IPad without internet connection?
parts:
Hi all, 

I have been trying to figure out how to run a Shiny app on an IPad with no internet connection.  

Has any one else encountered a similar situation? If so, have you been able to find a workaround?  

Thanks!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Running Shiny on IPad without internet connection?
parts:
It's not possible, as you need a connection to a server of some kind.

What is it your app would do, exactly? Some very basic types of offline interactivity are coming soon with the crosstalk package.
